title: RunResult
description: CANONICAL contract schema (v1.2.0), frozen by the PMs. RunResult flows from the engine to consumers, so this schema is deliberately tolerant of EXTRA top-level fields (forward compatibility: consumers must not crash on unknowns) while every required field must be present. Validation requires ajv-formats (uuid, date-time). Changes only via the contract-change process in docs/engineering-workflow.md.

runId.description: Matches the RunConfig.id that produced this result.

status.description: The ONLY flow control. Consumers render from status + error; they never infer failure from missing fields.

error.description: null when status = 'succeeded'; populated when status = 'failed'.

code.description: Producers emit exactly one of the canonical codes: INVALID_CONFIG, COMPILE_ERROR, ESTIMATION_FAILED, TIMEOUT, ENGINE_CRASH. Typed as an open string so consumers tolerate codes added by future contract versions.

message.description: Human-readable, analyst-facing explanation with a suggested next step. Engine-native diagnostics belong in raw, verbatim.

frontier.description: Pareto frontier rows; null when status = 'failed'. On success every row carries the six default fields. A value may legitimately be 0.

raw.description: The COMPLETE, unmodified engine output object — verbatim, never re-keyed or pruned. Schema-less by contract: its shape may vary by config and QRE version; consumers render whatever arrives. null is permitted ONLY on failure, and only when the engine produced no output at all (TIMEOUT, ENGINE_CRASH); when the engine emitted structured diagnostics, raw carries them verbatim.

qreVersion.description: The engine version that ACTUALLY executed, self-reported by the engine/package at runtime — never a hardcoded constant. This is the authoritative reproducibility anchor for the run.

frontierRow.description: One Pareto-optimal estimate row. Six defaults are required; further fields ride in `additional` using the same metric envelope.

additional.description: Optional result fields reported for this row, keyed by the app-facing names in contracts/types.ts RESULT_FIELD_KEYS where possible. Unknown keys are tolerated for forward compatibility.

numericMetric.description: One numeric metric. `value` is ALWAYS a number in the declared `unit`; math, sorting, plotting, and comparison use value+unit. `display` is human-friendly rendering; consumers must NEVER parse or compute from it.

factoryMetric.description: Magic-state factories used, represented as state type x number of copies. Empty value array means no factories.

fieldMetric.description: An optional result field. Numeric optional fields should use numeric values; non-numeric fields (source, FEASIBILITY, ASSUMPTIONS, NAME, MOLECULE, etc.) may use strings, booleans, arrays, or objects. `display` remains the renderable human form.
